content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GJUST Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GJUST Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GJUST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the GJUST recruitment is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, consisting of 1 Research Assistant post and 1 Field Staff post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is via email. Candidates need to send their CV and documents to the specified email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Field Staff?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a graduate in Social & Human Sciences with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for the Field Staff position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for these project-based positions at GJUST, Hisar.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification for Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The applicant must hold a Postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these positions are project-based and temporary in nature, funded by the HSHEC project at GJUST, Hisar.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send my application?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to [email protected] with the subject line clearly mentioning the post applied for under the HSHEC project.
